inline_prompts: You are given a string S consisting of six types of characters: (, ), [, ], <, >. A string T is called a colorful bracket sequence if it satisfies the following condition: It is possible to turn T into an empty string by repeating the following operation any number of times (possibly zero): - If there exists a contiguous substring of T that is one of (), [], or <>, choose one such substring and delete it. - If the deleted substring was at the beginning or end of T, the remainder becomes the new T. - Otherwise, concatenate the part before the deleted substring and the part after the deleted substring, and that becomes the new T.
